manifest.title: Tome of Heroes (Sample Pack)
manifest.description: Sample modular supplement demonstrating 2024-compatible third-party subclasses, species, backgrounds, and spells.

subclasses.name: Beer Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics of the Beer Domain honor fellowship, celebration, warmth, and hospitality.

3.Intoxicating Blessing: You can bless an ordinary beverage. When consumed as a bonus action, the drinker gains temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier and advantage on saving throws against fear.

6.Warmth of the Hearth: Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points, you can also remove the Poisoned condition from one target.

17.Endless Barrel: Once per long rest, you can conjure a cask of celestial brew that grants the effects of a Heroes' Feast spell in 10 minutes.

species.name: Derro
species.description: Stout, grey-skinned subterranean humanoids known for their resilience and erratic innate magic.

traits.Sunlight Sensitivity: You have disadvantage on attack rolls and Perception checks that rely on sight when you or your target is in direct sunlight.
traits.Innate Magic: You know the Minor Illusion cantrip. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for it.

backgrounds.name: Brewmaster
backgrounds.description: You spent years mastering fermentation, tavern camaraderie, and hospitality.

spells.name: Caustic Brew
spells.description: A stream of acid emanates from you in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be covered in acid.
